description: Claude 3 Haiku is Anthropic's fastest and most cost-effective model, designed for lightweight tasks requiring near-instant responses. Ideal for customer interactions, content moderation, and high-volume applications.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text and image data using Constitutional AI (CAI) methods.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Constitutional AI (CAI) and optimized for speed and efficiency.

evaluation.performanceSummary: Fastest Claude model with strong performance for its size. Optimized for speed and cost while maintaining safety standards.

knownLimitations: Less capable than Sonnet and Opus on complex tasks
May struggle with nuanced or multi-step reasoning
May generate incorrect or misleading information

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Anthropic uses Constitutional AI to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Constitutional AI training and content filtering optimized for speed.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data is not used to train models by default.

access.rateLimits: Varies by usage tier - higher limits available

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Anthropic), also available via AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
